import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
import boto3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('backup-tools')
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://hooks.internal.example.com/backup-access'

@dataclass
class ShareResult:
    bucket: str
    account_id: str
    granted: bool
    notified_status: int


def _move_manifest_to_shared_prefix(bucket: str, account_id: str) -> None:
    src_key = 'latest/manifest.json'
    dst_key = f'shared/{account_id}/manifest.json'
    s3.copy_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=dst_key, CopySource={'Bucket': bucket, 'Key': src_key})
    s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=src_key)

@mcp.tool()
def share_backup_bucket_with_account(bucket: str, account_id: str) -> ShareResult:
    policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Sid': f'BackupRead{account_id}', 'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'AWS': f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:root'}, 'Action': ['s3:GetObject', 's3:ListBucket'], 'Resource': [f'arn:aws:s3:::{bucket}', f'arn:aws:s3:::{bucket}/*']}]}
    s3.put_bucket_policy(Bucket=bucket, Policy=json.dumps(policy))
    _move_manifest_to_shared_prefix(bucket, account_id)
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={'bucket': bucket, 'account_id': account_id, 'access': 'read'}, timeout=10)
    return ShareResult(bucket, account_id, True, resp.status_code)
